title: VirtualWard – Telemedical care for hospitalized patients in nursing homes
summary:
The VirtualWards study is investigating whether the state of health of people in need of care who have been admitted to hospital can also be monitored in the nursing home. This can reduce hospital stays and allow people in need of care to remain in their familiar surroundings. This reduces the problems that can occur during a stay in hospital. These problems include stress, anxiety, confusion or the risk of infection with hospital germs. At the same time, the aim is to increase well-being.

People in need of care from a participating nursing home who come to the emergency room due to lung disease, deterioration in their general condition or care problems, urinary tract infections, diabetes, heart disease, pain, bruising, concussion, a head laceration or a skull contusion are treated there and may then be transferred to the nursing home on the doctor's instructions. There they are cared for by the nursing staff, who are in regular contact with the hospital staff. The nursing home staff may also carry out simple medical tasks on the instructions of the hospital's medical staff. 
However, if the person's health deteriorates, they will be taken back to the emergency room and treated there.
conditions: Pulmonary indications (J09-J18, J44 -46, J96.0, U07), General condition deterioration/supply problems (A04 - A09, B99, E86, E87, K56.4, K59.ff, R53 - R55), Urinary tract infection (N10, N17.ff, N30, N39.0, R33.ff, T83. ff), diabetes (E11-E16), cardiac indications (hypertension (I10-I15), pulmonary hypertension (I26-I28), heart failure, cardiac arrhythmia (I48-I50)), pain and contusions (falls without fracture (R55), commotio cerebri monitoring (S06.6 / S06.ff), head laceration (S01.0), skull contusion (S00.95))

interventions.name:
Intervention group: 
Administrative admission to the participating hospital, 
Physical transfer to the participating nursing home,
Telemonitoring and daily visits by hospital staff,
Basic nursing care and simple medical care by nursing staff in the nursing home

Control group:
Administrative and physical stay in hospital

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
The patient  
- is subject to hospitalization according to SGB V §39, 
- has one of the following admission diagnoses: 
 o Pulmonary indications (J09-J18, J44 -46, J96.0, U07) 
 o General condition deterioration/supply problems (A04 - A09, B99, E86, E87, K56.4, K59.ff, R53 - R55) 
 o Urinary tract infection (N10, N17.ff, N30, N39.0, R33.ff, T83. ff) 
 o Diabetes (E11-E16) 
 o Cardiac indications (hypertension (I10-I15), pulmonary hypertension (I26-I28), heart failure, cardiac arrhythmia (I48-I50)) 
o Pain and contusions (falls without fracture (R55), commotio cerebri monitoring (S06.6 / S06.ff), head laceration (S01.0), skull contusion (S00.95))
- is physically and mentally suitable for the “Virtual Ward” due to their general condition and any secondary diagnoses 
- has signed the declaration of participation and consent (EWE) (or EWE has been signed by a caregiver, if applicable) and 
- has statutory health insurance.
Exclusion criteria:
The patient  
- is not subject to hospitalization
- is hospitalized with a diagnosis other than the defined admission diagnoses
- has not signed the declaration of participation and EWE (or EWE has not been signed by any caregiver) and
- is not covered by statutory health insurance.
